info.name: Adyen Get All Balance Accounts of an Account Holder

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the account holder.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items that you want to skip.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of items returned per page, maximum 100 items. By default, the response returns 10 items per page.

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of the balance accounts associated with an account holder. To fetch multiple pages, use the query parameters. 

For example, to limit the page to 5 balance accounts and skip the first 10, use `/accountHolders/{id}/balanceAccounts?limit=5&offset=10`.
